linear predictor. then just add a new entry in the model with that
particular covariate combination and set the response to NA.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Computing exceedance probability
parts:
Either use

inla.posterior.sample()

or use linear-combinations to extract such information.

with linear combinations, you get the marginal, and you can use
inla.pmarginal() to compute the CDF.

for linear combinations, see the FAQ at r-inla.org

H
